## Change

Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior. Link the agreed scope or discussion.

## Validation

List commands actually run, hardware used, and results. Identify checks that were unavailable. Distinguish source emission, SDK compilation, and GPU execution.

For performance changes, identify the baseline, workload, precision, timing boundaries, correctness/quality checks, raw samples, and regressions. Otherwise write “Not applicable.”

## Scope and remaining limits

Describe material limitations and affected documentation. Keep claims within the evidence supplied.

Before submitting code, coordinate contribution terms with the maintainer as described in [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/demier-demier/jade-compute/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md). Public availability does not grant an open-source license for project-authored code.
